summary: Fixed Todo.__init__ and Todo.from_dict to validate text field is not empty or whitespace-only
implementation_approach: Added text validation in __post_init__ method to check if text.strip() is empty, raising ValueError with message 'Todo text cannot be empty'. This matches the existing validation in rename() method.
risks: Minimal - the validation is consistent with existing rename() method behavior. Any code directly creating Todo objects with empty/whitespace text will now raise ValueError.
limitations: Text with leading/trailing whitespace is preserved (not auto-stripped) - this matches expected behavior from the issue.
